items.title: A Giant Freighter Vanished. Nobody Heard a Distress Call.
items.prompt:
Create ONE finished, visually audacious YouTube thumbnail for Paper Detour, landscape 16:9, request 3840x2160 UHD. This is a new image, supplied images are material/lighting references only, NOT composition templates. Subject: the accepted historical story of the Edmund Fitzgerald, Lake Superior, November 1975. Premium handmade cut-paper and sculpted cardstock diorama, sophisticated cinematic lighting, crisp carefully cut contours, selectively visible fibers and layered depth, believable tactile construction and contact shadows. Strong poster-like hierarchy and large shapes readable at 320px. Visually arresting and emotionally serious rather than cute toys. Do not coat everything in identical coarse crumpled texture. Integrate the exact requested English lettering into the generated image: huge broad rounded heavy sans-serif cut-paper letters, clean spacing, physical thickness and subtle dark contact shadow. Text lives inside generous margins; no tiny subtext, extra labels, channel logo, watermark, borders or collage panels. Avoid putting critical subject/text at lower-right duration badge area. No invented explosion, sinking mechanism, bodies, archival document, coordinates or exact historic instrument readings. No claim of photographic reconstruction.
COMPOSITION: Fearsome ultra-low waterline view, severe perspective. A single ENORMOUS intact 1970s Great Lakes ore freighter's blunt reddish bow and white forward pilothouse tower over the viewer on the right, filling 65% of the image. Long cargo deck recedes diagonally into opaque horizontal white snow at upper-right, its stern lost in weather, not dissolving or breaking. A black trough of layered lake water rises in foreground, white sharp cut-paper spray streaks drive the eye toward the warm tiny bridge windows. Ship feels truly monumental and vulnerable, not a small model placed on a table. Navy/black sea, vermilion hull, ice-white blizzard; striking clean contrast, enough large dark quiet area on left for text. TEXT EXACTLY: "NO SOS HEARD", three enormous stacked lines on left, cream NO, vivid warm yellow SOS, cream HEARD. No radio prop. Reference 1 supplies tactile storm water; reference 2 supplies broad Great Lakes freighter configuration only; copy neither scene nor vessel lettering.
